template: Compare each separated piece of every candidate with the target shape: decide which single candidate could be slid and turned, without being flipped over, to reproduce the target exactly, and say what disqualifies one of the candidates you rejected. State your conclusion, justify it by describing how you tried to fit the pieces together, and end with a confidence score from 0 to 1.

independent_derivation.method: separate formulas and geometry traversals; generator answer derivation is not called

deterministic_subfact_dependency_check.method: explicit semantic dependency rules plus empirical conditional-variation checks for suspected relationships; the line-order parity rule is evaluated over all 3000 source records

correct_candidate.verification_basis: exhaustive PNG decode plus domain renderer/geometry recovery
